infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Queenix uses your camera to scan gym QR codes, and to scan IDs, car plates, receipts and signed forms.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Queenix uses your photos to set your profile picture and to attach documents you choose.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Queenix uses Face ID for secure authentication.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Queenix to access your photos for your profile picture.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Queenix to use the camera to scan member QR codes at the door.
